prompt: A dwarven side chamber crudely converted into a goblin warren, filthy hide partitions strung between carved pillars, a low fire, stolen sacks of salt stacked in a corner, bones and refuse, seen from a dark doorway
motion: The fire flickers across the hides. A shadow crosses behind a partition. The camera holds in the dark doorway, then pushes very slowly forward.
say: The goblins had been living in it for perhaps forty years. And there, stacked against a carved pillar older than the kingdom, were six weeks of stolen salt.
sfx: A crackling fire, muttering voices in a strange tongue, hides moving, dripping
